terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A fictional long-wheelbase three-door widebody hot-hatch delivery car about 4.3 m long: short rounded nose with twin round projector headlamps and small amber fog lamps in a black mesh lower grille, flared box wheel arches, short fastback Kammback tail, glossy teal-turquoise metallic paint on the body with a cream-white roof and a thin cream stripe over the bonnet, black glass windows, black plastic side skirts and front splitter, a brushed aluminium roof rack carrying a rounded insulated orange delivery cargo box strapped down with dark canvas straps, a small teal translucent beacon dome on the roof front, plain blank white number plates. Vehicle body only with no wheels and no tyres at all: the wheel arches are empty dark openings with nothing inside them, the body shown floating slightly above the floor. Photoreal studio product render of a clean, freshly washed, undamaged vehicle body, physically based materials, crisp panel gaps, high detail. All windows are fully opaque glossy black privacy glass, the interior is not visible at all. Seen from the front-left side at a 30 degree angle, photographed from far away with a long telephoto lens so there is almost no perspective distortion, the whole vehicle small in the frame with generous empty margin. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
